description: Several large colorful Lego-style blocks sit on the bed in front of the pillow, including a blue base with white, green, yellow, and red pieces attached. The right hand reaches in to grasp and lift the stacked blocks as the left hand hovers nearby, then the right hand pulls a yellow-and-red section apart, sets pieces down, and continues separating the red and green blocks while the left hand steadies and slides the remaining base pieces before both hands release, leaving the blocks scattered.
